_comment_workspace: OPERATOR-PRIVILEGED BOOTSTRAP WORKSPACE (DR-035). This workspace acts AS THE OPERATOR's GitHub account (the deliberate INVERSE of the fleet attribution discipline) so it can create the scoped Apps the chicken-and-egg forbids a scoped App from creating. It runs with NO per-action prompts, fenced ONLY by the two structural rails below. NEVER reuse this workspace as a fleet agent. See .claude/rules/macf-bootstrap-safety.md + README.md.
_comment_attribution_omission: DELIBERATE OMISSION (DR-035 Boundaries): the fleet attribution-guard hooks (check-gh-token.sh / check-gh-attribution.sh / check-mention-routing.sh / check-lgtm-gate.sh / check-close-keyword.sh) are intentionally ABSENT here. A fleet agent missing check-gh-token would be a bug; here the absence is the point — this workspace is SUPPOSED to act as the operator, not a ghs_ bot token. The only hooks are the two destructive-deny rails (URL allowlist + gh guard).
_comment_rails: Two structural rails fence the operator's blast radius without per-action prompts: (1) permissions.deny on the Bash/gh destructive surface + the check-bootstrap-gh-guard.sh PreToolUse(Bash) hook; (2) the check-bootstrap-url-allowlist.sh PreToolUse hook on the chrome-devtools MCP browser surface. CRITICAL: the chrome-devtools MCP tools are in allow (NOT deny) — a permissions.deny fires BEFORE PreToolUse hooks and skips them, so denying the tool would skip the URL guard entirely; and permissions.deny cannot arg-match mcp__* tools anyway.
